title: fix(plugin-form): a line-items column over a formula takes the type its returnType declares
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Nf3gqWSittou77go2LaJkT)_

Fixes #34286

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：明细（record:line_items / 主从表）里只写字段名的列，如果那个字段是公式（或汇总），列类型改按公式声明的 `returnType` 推导；货币公式现在打印 `$157,780.00` / `157,780` 这样的金额，而不是裸数字 `157780`。
- 为什么改：报价单、发票打印的明细里，货币公式列显示成未格式化的数字，而同一个值在记录详情页和普通货币列里是格式化的，客户看到的单据不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个纯函数（列类型推导）；没有 `returnType` 的公式、手写了 `type` 的列、普通货币字段都和以前一样。回滚就是撤销这一个 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts` 的 `columnValueType`（新）和它在 `hydrateColumns` 里的那一处调用。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.childFieldHydration-12854.test.tsx`，预期 9 个用例全绿，其中 `#34286` 一组 4 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`hydrateColumns` (and the internal `deriveColumn`, for symmetry) in `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts` now map a child field through a new private `columnValueType(d)` before `fieldTypeToColumnType`:

- a `summary` that declares its currency (`summaryDeclaresCurrency`, already exported by `@object-ui/fields`, the formula cell's own test) → `currency`;
- otherwise a `formula` / `summary` field's declared `returnType`, as declared;
- with neither, the field's own `type`, so the column hydrates exactly as before (`text`);
- every other field type is unchanged.

This is the formula cell's reading (`FormulaCellRenderer` in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`), applied to the declaration alone: a column is typed before any value exists, so the cell's last arm (a JS number drawn as a number) has no counterpart, and nothing is inferred from the expression. No second return-type table: the declared value type is a field type, and the existing `fieldTypeToColumnType` maps it.

Mappings: `currency` → `currency`; `number` → `number` (the formula's `scale` still carried by the computed branch); `date` → `date`; `boolean` → `select` with the two session-language option labels a boolean field gets (`optionsFor` now reads the value type); `text` → `text`. The spec `returnType` enum has no `percent`, so none is added.

Unchanged: a column with an authored `type` is returned as written; the column stays computed and read-only (`isExpressionComputedField`); a hydrated `currency` column with an authored `scale` is still reported by `reportCurrencyColumnScale`; the column's currency is resolved where every currency column's is (`GridField` `columnCurrencies`, filled from the child field's own `currencyConfig` by `parentCurrencyFieldsOf`, which reads any field type).

## Tests

- `LineItemsPanel.childFieldHydration-12854.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` in the existing harness: a name-only column over a `returnType: 'currency'` formula prints `$157,780.00` (USD tenant); `returnType: 'number'` prints `157,780`; CONTROL no `returnType` prints `157780` as before; CONTROL an authored `type: 'number'` wins.
- `deriveMasterDetail.test.ts`, new top-level `describe`: currency / number (+ scale) / date / boolean (select + labels) / text mappings; a summary declaring a currency → `currency`; CONTROL a formula with no `returnType` and a summary with no currency stay `text`; CONTROL authored type wins and a plain currency field stays `currency`.

## Acceptance notes

- `deriveColumns` never reaches a `formula` / `summary` field: the spec's `deriveInlineGridColumns` skips both as non-editable (`INLINE_GRID_NON_EDITABLE_TYPES`), so only the hydration path (`record:line_items` and the master-detail block's explicit `columns`, both through `hydrateColumns`) is live. `deriveColumn` takes the same rule so the two cannot drift.
- A `number` column's read-only text is `toLocaleString` with no minimum fraction digits (`GridField` `cellDisplayText`), so a declared `scale` rounds the stored computed value but does not pad the display. Pre-existing for every number column; not changed here.
- A hydrated `summary` column is not `computed` (a summary has no `expression`), so in an editable panel it renders an input, as it did as `text` before. Pre-existing.
- The card's print door (`POST /api/v1/print/records`) renders the console page, whose `record:line_items` is `LineItemsPanel` → `hydrateColumns`; the panel pin reproduces the card's `157780` on main (ablation below). The print door itself was not driven end to end: NOT MEASURED.

## Verification

All at head `c922a5f0` (branch merged with `origin/main` f9120b86; main moved no file this diff reads).

- Symptom on main, measured: ablation A below is main's rule for a formula (its `type` mapped as is); the panel cell read `157780` where the pin expects `$157,780.00`, the card's text.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.test.ts packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.childFieldHydration-12854.test.tsx` (from `ui/`): `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 61 passed (61)`.
- Whole package, `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 232 passed (232)`, `Tests 2582 passed | 1 skipped (2583)` (run on `0fbbd921`, before the main merge; the merge touched no `ui/packages/{plugin-form,fields,core,i18n}` file).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint` on the three touched source/test files: 0 errors (21 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings).
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 38 families, each run, all `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: `38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

<details><summary>Ablations (node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- A: `return typeof d?.returnType === 'string' ? d.returnType : type;` → `return type;` (blob 06c9c5aa → 6024bd16): 4 red, the currency and number pins in both files (`Expected $157,780.00, Received 157780`; `Expected /^157,780$/, Received 157780`). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- B: delete `if (type === 'summary' && summaryDeclaresCurrency(d)) return 'currency';` (blob 06c9c5aa → c9a3bbaa): 1 red, the summary pin. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The tests import `./deriveMasterDetail` by relative path (source), so no dist leg applies.
</details>
